title: A blueprint of Bead's builder, bead-blueprint/1: the services a .proto declares, resolved, in the runtime's words (decision 0022)
description: What one entry holds, in no language's words: no file option, no class, no path of a target's. What spans entries — one id and one name a scope, folded as spec 16.6 folds; the reservations; a failure its service lacks; a proto binding whose message proto does not list — is beadc check's, by rule name. A reader refuses a format it does not know, and a feature of requires it does not know.

format.description: The format and its major: a reader refuses another.

specVersion.description: The version of spec/spec.md whose sections 16 and 17 its producer follows.

requires.description: The features it uses beyond the base, each by its name, as JOSE's crit lists them (RFC 7515 §4.1.11): a reader refuses one it does not know, and names it.

proto.description: What a front end read from a .proto, when it read one: the files that declare a service or a message a binding names, and those messages. Absent from a blueprint written by hand, whose bindings are all native.

files.description: The .proto files that declare one of its services or one of its messages, by path.

messages.description: The messages a binding names, by full name, each with the file that declares it: what a target imports, never their fields.

reservedServices.description: The service ids and names its files' packages retired, which none of its services takes.

services.description: Its services, by id: one blueprint is one id space.

path.description: Its path from its root, as an import names it, parts by /.

package.description: Its protobuf package; empty for none.

file.description: The path, among its files, of the file that declares it.

serviceName.description: What its classes and routes are named after: its .proto name, a trailing Service taken off.

failures.description: Its catalogue (spec 9.5), by code: what its procedures answer, each by its name.

reserved.description: The procedure ids and names, and the failure codes, it retired, which none of its procedures and failures takes.

proto.description: Where a front end read it: its file's path, among proto's files, and its full name.

file.description: The path, among its files, of the file that declares it.

procedureKind.description: How it is called (spec 16.11): never its envelopes' kind.

failures.description: The names of its service's catalogue it may answer, in their codes' order.

maximumPayloadBytes.description: The most bytes a payload of it holds, its request's and its result's; left out, the router's alone.

binding.description: A payload's encoding (spec 17), and for proto alone its message: raw, text and json are bead.Raw's, bead.Text's and bead.Json's, which the blueprint does not repeat.

admission.description: Who may call it, its file's and its service's resolved: every call, a call with a session, or a hook the side that answers is given by its name — the runtime's AdmissionRule.

deprecation.description: Deprecated, with what to use instead when it says.

description.description: Its leading comment, by the description rule of builder/README.md: documentation, which no rule of beadc breaking reads.

fullName.description: A protobuf full name, its package and its nesting parted by dots.

serviceName.description: An upper-case ASCII letter, then 62 ASCII letters or digits at most.

failureName.description: Its enum value's name, the enum's prefix taken off: upper-case ASCII letters and digits in words parted by one underscore.

ranges.description: Ids from first to last, both included, in ascending order.
